component.name: Cadence
component.summary: An Apple Music-style player for your Navidrome server

description.p: Cadence plays the music on your own Navidrome (Subsonic / OpenSubsonic) server in a clean, big-screen layout. It is built to be driven with arrow keys, a TV remote or a game controller, and it works with a mouse and keyboard too.
Features include synced lyrics, an Up next queue, search with an on-screen keyboard, album, artist and playlist pages, light and dark themes, and keyboard and controller shortcuts.
Cadence is an independent project. It is not affiliated with Apple or Navidrome.
